dialog.title: Send feedback
dialog.description: Opens a new issue on {{repo}} in a new tab. You can review and edit it there before it's posted; issues are public.
dialog.storeHint: A store app that doesn't work? Use Report a problem on its store page, so the report reaches whoever maintains it.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.description: Something doesn't work the way it should.

change.title: Suggest a change
change.description: Something works, but it should work differently.

appReport.title: Report a problem with {{app}}
appReport.description: Opens a new issue for {{where}} in a new tab, with the app and this server's details filled in. You review it there before it's posted; issues are public.
appReport.whereCatalog: the {{name}} catalog, which maintains this app
appReport.logsWarning: Remove passwords, tokens and addresses before you continue.
appReport.logsTruncated: Only the end of the logs fits in the link.
appReport.noContainers: No containers found for this app.
